name: Embrace The Chaos
description:
Whenever a creature within short range takes damage, you gain 1 MP.

Your MP may be spent on your abilities as normal but you may also convert MP, one for one, into +1d bonuses to your skill checks, at any time.

At the end of each of your turns, your MP is reduced to 0 —unless you hit with an attack and deal damage. If you did, convert all remaining MP, one for one, to +1d skill check bonuses and distribute them among any number of other creatures within short range. Recipients must use these bonuses on their next turn or lose them.

Describe how you turn the chaos of battle to your advantage.

improvements.name: Bloodlust
improvements.description: Once per round, you may convert 1 MP to a +1d damage roll bonus.

improvements.name: Chaos Reigns
improvements.description: You also gain MP for damage dealt to creatures within medium range.

improvements.name: Love A Good Fight
improvements.description: On your turn, you may convert any number of MP to d12 engagement dice, which expire after 1 round. These cannot be passed to other creatures.

improvements.name: Wild Brawl
improvements.description: On your turn, you may convert MP to half actions.
